_meta.method: Fare is charged on route distance, not station count. Segment distances were read directly from GMRC for all 55 adjacent track segments; slab cuts were located by binary-searching station pairs around each boundary.
_meta.verification: A cumulative-distance graph built from these segments reproduced GMRC's station_count on 53/53 sampled pairs and its station_km to within 0.02km (2-decimal rounding). Of 58 pairs lying within 0.12km of a slab cut, 52 matched the slab rule; the 6 that did not are listed in `overrides`.
_meta.caveat: GMRC's internal chargeable distance differs from its displayed station_km by up to ~0.06km in both directions, so pairs sitting very close to a cut can misclassify. Pairs within 0.12km of a cut were checked exhaustively; pairs outside that window were not. ~231 of 1431 possible pairs were sampled.
_meta.unverified: Pairs outside the 0.12km at-risk window around each slab cut have not been individually checked (see `caveat`).
_meta.notApplied: The CSC/NCMC 10% discount is confirmed (GMRC fare-rules page, see app/src/data/metroInfo.json) but is deliberately not applied here - fares in this file are token fares, and the discount is shown as text only.
